raw_card.answer: former United States Senator from California, newly elected Teachta Dála
raw_card.claim: Barbara Boxer is the former United States Senator from California and is taking her seat as a newly elected Teachta Dála.

raw_card.answer: former United States Senator from California, member of the Marin County Board of Supervisors, member of the United States House of Representatives
raw_card.claim: Barbara Boxer is the former United States Senator from California, served on the Marin County Board of Supervisors from 1976 to 1982, and was elected to the United States House of Representatives in 1982 where she served for a decade.
